from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentClassification(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from one document to determine its case type."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The document title as provided")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The case type for this document, as one of: 刑事案件, 执行案件, 民事案件")
    key_indicators: list[str] = Field(description="Key terms or phrases that indicate the case type")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the document supporting the classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    document_classifications: list[DocumentClassification]
